differences: Text A chooses the target when the end step trigger is put on the stack, so the target can be responded to and the ability fizzles if it is gone; Text B chooses the target only on resolution ('you may choose target creature you control. If you do...'), so the target choice is made at a different time.
In Text A the 'you may' applies to gaining the life; in Text B it applies to choosing the target, with the life gain conditional on that choice.
